title: Product Detail
content: Build complete product detail page. Layout: two columns - gallery left, details right. Image gallery: main large image, thumbnail strip below, click to change, lightbox on click, zoom on hover. Product info: breadcrumbs, product name (text-2xl font-bold), brand, star rating with review count, price, short description. Variants: color swatches, size buttons with availability. Quantity selector: plus/minus. Actions: "Add to Cart", "Add to Wishlist", "Share". Tabs below: Description, Specifications, Reviews. Related products at bottom.

variants.simple: Create product page with image gallery, description, variants, and add to cart.
variants.detailed: Build complete product detail page. Layout: two columns - gallery left, details right. Image gallery: main large image, thumbnail strip below, click to change, lightbox on click, zoom on hover. Product info: breadcrumbs, product name (text-2xl font-bold), brand, star rating with review count, price, short description. Variants: color swatches, size buttons with availability. Quantity selector: plus/minus. Actions: "Add to Cart", "Add to Wishlist", "Share". Tabs below: Description, Specifications, Reviews. Related products at bottom.
variants.advanced: Build complete product detail page with full e-commerce functionality. Layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4, two columns on desktop (grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8), gallery on top for mobile. Image gallery section: main image container (aspect-square relative), thumbnail strip below (flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto). Main image: object-contain bg-gray-50 rounded-lg, click opens lightbox modal with zoom and navigation, hover shows magnified view (scale-150 at cursor position). Thumbnails: w-16 h-16 rounded border-2, border-black when active, click to change main image. Lightbox: full-screen modal with navigation arrows, close button, swipe on mobile. Product info section: breadcrumbs (Home > Category > Subcategory > Product), product name (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold), brand link (text-gray-500), star rating display with review count link ("4.5 ★ (128 reviews)"), price section (text-3xl font-bold, sale price with original struck through), short description paragraph. Variants section: color selector with swatches showing color name, size selector buttons with availability (in-stock, low-stock warning, out-of-stock disabled), material/style options if applicable. Quantity selector: plus/minus buttons with input, min 1, max based on stock. Action buttons: "Add to Cart" (bg-black text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-lg w-full md:w-auto, loading state with spinner), "Add to Wishlist" (outline button with Heart icon), "Share" (dropdown with social options). Stock info: "In Stock" green badge or "Only 3 left" warning, shipping estimate ("Ships in 1-2 business days"). Tabs/Accordion below: Description (rich text with images), Specifications (key-value table), Reviews (full review section component), Shipping & Returns (policy info). Related products carousel at bottom. Sticky add to cart bar on mobile: fixed bottom-0, shows on scroll past main CTA, contains price, quantity, Add button. Structured data: JSON-LD for SEO. Accessibility: proper headings hierarchy, image alts, focusable elements.
